description: This PHP source file defines the AccruedInterest class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for financial calculations related to securities. It contains methods for calculating accrued interest on securities that pay periodic or at maturity, utilizing various financial constants and validation functions.

classes.name: AccruedInterest
classes.description: Class providing methods to calculate accrued interest for securities, either periodically or at maturity.

methods.name: periodic
methods.description: Calculates the accrued interest for a security that pays periodic interest, based on issue date, first interest date, settlement date, rate, par value, frequency, and basis.

methods.name: atMaturity
methods.description: Calculates the accrued interest for a security that pays at maturity, based on issue date, settlement date, rate, par value, and basis.
